sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Mình sẽ mua 2 cái nếu giá tốt is the quick money check before you agree to a ride, ticket, item, or service. It keeps the exchange focused on I will buy two if the price is..., so the answer can be a number, calculator screen, or typed price.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Ask Mình sẽ mua 2 cái nếu giá tốt before you hand over money. Keep the item, ticket, ride screen, or calculator visible so the price can be shown instead of explained quickly.
